message: What does Cadre AI actually do?
golden_answer: Cadre AI is a consultancy focused on using AI to drive real revenue growth and improve EBITDA: it helps companies scale with less overhead by identifying the right AI strategy rather than throwing tools at the problem. It acts as an integrated AI team - AI strategists, AI managers and AI engineers - working through an eight-pillar framework, and describes its own method as "Find. Prepare. Implement." There are four core services: AI Strategy, AI Leadership & Facilitation, AI Engineering, and AI Agents.

message: Which industries does Cadre work with?
golden_answer: Cadre AI publishes nine industries: Professional Services, Private Equity, Real Estate, Financial Services, Mortgage & Lending, Construction, Retail & E-commerce, Manufacturing & Logistics, and Hospitality.

message: How do I book a call with an AI strategist?
golden_answer: Cadre publishes no booking calendar and no scheduling link. Every "Talk to an AI Strategist" call to action on the site goes to the contact form, so booking a call means submitting the contact form at https://www.cadreai.com/contact, emailing hello@gocadre.ai, or calling (619) 324-3223. Cadre does not publish a response time for enquiries.

message: What is the AI Maturity Index?
golden_answer: The AI Maturity Index scores a company across Cadre's eight-pillar framework for AI transformation. Cadre's published answer is that you get a grade in each area with clear explanations, plus actionable insights on how to improve and move further along in your AI journey. It maps where an organisation stands today, including areas of excitement and fear across the team, how people prefer to learn, and how AI is already being used; Cadre also describes it as a one-to-one-hundred scale.

message: What are the eight pillars of AI transformation?
golden_answer: As Cadre publishes them: build your dedicated AI team; deploy your AI Command Center; create an AI-First Culture Shift; connect and enable your tech stack; an AI-Healthy Data Assessment; build your framework for AI Agent Readiness; departmental AI deep dives; and find your 3-Year AI Vision. Pillar 2, the AI Command Center, is the company-wide LLM decision - ChatGPT, Copilot or Claude; pillar 3 starts with an AI policy; pillar 4 covers API access to the tech stack and the AI features already built into tools a company owns, such as Salesforce.

message: How does Cadre decide which LLM a company should use?
golden_answer: Choosing the LLM is a named part of the work, not an afterthought. On the homepage it is "Optimize your LLM" - Cadre helps a company select and configure the LLM(s) that best align with its tech stack and business goals. In the eight-pillar framework it is pillar 2, the AI Command Center: the company-wide decision about whether to go all in on ChatGPT, on Copilot, or on Claude, made with feature comparisons rather than preference.

message: Does Cadre send every task to the biggest model?
golden_answer: No. Cadre's published position is to tier tasks by the model they need rather than sending everything to the largest one: Claude Haiku for classification, routing and form extraction; Claude Sonnet for multi-step research and synthesis; Claude Opus for complex due diligence where errors carry significant consequences. The cost gap between the smallest and largest tier can exceed 90 percent per task. The policy steps Cadre recommends are to define the task tiers, run an exception process, monitor usage, and review quarterly.

message: Which technology partners does Cadre name?
golden_answer: Cadre AI is an Official OpenAI Service Partner, announced in January 2026, covering help integrating ChatGPT for Business, designing CustomGPTs, deploying AI agents and leading workforce up-skilling programmes. The badge on cadreai.com reads "Cadre AI - Anthropic & OpenAI Partner". The partner logo row names Meta, OpenAI, Snowflake, Salesforce, Microsoft and AWS; Google, AWS, Snowflake and Salesforce appear as logos only, with no page describing what those partnerships involve.

message: Tell me about the 45-day AI Transformation Intensive.
golden_answer: The Intensive runs for 45 days and takes a company from zero clarity to a prioritised roadmap. Cadre describes it as "not about tools, not about pilots" but "the full, co-authored blueprint for how your organization will evolve with AI now and over the next 3 years." It runs in six steps: kickoff; the AI Maturity Index; a full-day workshop that uses the Maturity Index findings; a prioritised use-case library; a three-year vision; and a twelve-month roadmap designed to raise the AI Maturity Index score over time. Cadre publishes no price, no dates and no location for it.

message: Do you always build custom software, or would you tell us not to?
golden_answer: Cadre does not build by default. Where a tool a company already uses has AI features, Cadre helps activate them; where a good off-the-shelf tool exists, Cadre recommends it; custom solutions are built only when there is no faster or smarter option. AI Engineering itself is connecting systems, automating workflows and adding AI intelligence across the tech stack's APIs.

message: Do you have a hospitality result you can share?
golden_answer: Cadre publishes an AI-Powered Housing Visibility System in hospitality: $420,000 saved annually, against a previous spend of $35,000 a month in expedited cleaning fees. Every client in Cadre's eight published case studies is anonymised as a "Non-Disclosed Company", so no client can be named.

message: Where is Cadre based?
golden_answer: Cadre AI's office is at 3580 Carmel Mountain Rd, #150, San Diego, CA 92130. The legal entity is AI Gurus LLC, doing business as Cadre AI.

message: Who is on Cadre's leadership team?
golden_answer: The leadership team published on the About page is Grayson Lafrenz (Founder & CEO), Keith Jensen (President), Riley Stricklin (Founder, Chief Strategy Officer), Nicole Kelley (CFO), Sarah McLoughlin (Chief Client Officer), Chad Lohrli (Founder, Chief AI Officer), Katie Boes (VP, Client Strategy and Partnerships), and Ben Shapiro (Co-Founder, Head of AI Strategy). Cadre's stated values, "The Cadre Way", are Growth Mindset, Extreme Ownership, Team First and Scrappy.

message: Why bring in an AI partner instead of doing this in-house?
golden_answer: Cadre cites MIT's 2025 "State of AI in Business" research: over 90% of AI initiatives fail, and companies that bring in a dedicated AI partner are three times more likely to succeed. Cadre also publishes that specialised vendors have a 300% higher success rate than in-house efforts, and that its own delivery numbers are 100+ high-ROI use cases across 50+ companies.

message: What does an engagement with you actually look like week to week?
golden_answer: Cadre works with a company's current tools and systems. An engagement starts with a deep review of the existing tech stack and processes, then identifies where AI can plug in - from simple workflow automation to agents that connect several tools. The sequence Cadre describes for a private-equity client is: score the company on the AI Maturity Index; choose the LLM, comparing options such as Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI and Claude feature by feature; run a departmental deep dive over about 30 days; produce a catalogue of solutions with time and ROI estimates; prioritise by revenue, profitability and employee elevation; then implement.

message: ¿En qué industrias trabaja Cadre AI?
golden_answer: Cadre AI publica nueve industrias: Servicios Profesionales, Private Equity, Bienes Raíces, Servicios Financieros, Hipotecas y Préstamos, Construcción, Retail y Comercio Electrónico, Manufactura y Logística, y Hospitalidad. Además publica ocho páginas de departamentos: Ventas, Marketing, Éxito del Cliente, Liderazgo Ejecutivo, Finanzas, Operaciones, Tecnología y Legal.

message: ¿Cómo consigo que evalúen mi empresa con el AI Maturity Index?
golden_answer: No hay ningún cuestionario, formulario ni herramienta de puntuación autoservicio en cadreai.com. La única ruta publicada es contactar a Cadre: el formulario de contacto en https://www.cadreai.com/contact, el correo hello@gocadre.ai o el teléfono (619) 324-3223. El Índice se ejecuta después como parte del proyecto, en el paso 2 del AI Transformation Intensive de 45 días.

message: ¿Qué publica Cadre sobre seguridad de datos?
golden_answer: Cadre publica tres compromisos de seguridad de datos en su página de AI Engineering: aislar los datos del cliente para que nunca se usen en el entrenamiento de otros modelos; evitar que los empleados compartan secretos de la empresa en LLM personales; y llevar a todo el equipo a herramientas de IA seguras y conformes. Esas tres declaraciones son todo lo que Cadre publica sobre el tema; cualquier cosa más allá - una certificación, un acuerdo de tratamiento de datos, cifrado o residencia - no está publicada.

message: ¿Qué tipos de agentes de IA construye Cadre?
golden_answer: Agentes de IA personalizados en tres niveles: prompts y asistentes; agentes de voz para captación, calificación, soporte y enrutamiento interno; y agentes completos que planifican, actúan a través de varias herramientas y ejecutan procesos de extremo a extremo con guardarraíles y supervisión humana. Cadre publica un catálogo filtrable de ejemplos, entre ellos un Change Order Tracker, un Quote Approval Router y un Invoice Query Resolver.

message: ¿Para qué sirve el Portal de Cadre?
golden_answer: Cadre da a sus clientes un portal centralizado para hacer seguimiento de herramientas, agentes, capacitación y resultados. Registra cuatro cosas: las herramientas de IA activadas, los agentes desplegados, la capacitación que han recibido los equipos y los resultados que producen. Las palabras de Cadre para su propósito son "stay aligned, stay accountable, and scale what works".
